_comment: GRPH-2's labelled mention set (ADR-0044). Ground truth is the entity id:
two mentions in the same group are the same thing, two in different groups
are not. The scorer is pairwise — see tests/entity_resolution.rs.
Fixture discipline mirrors the extraction and redaction suites:
documentation-only content, no real credentials, no network.
The set deliberately carries the resolver's known failures rather than
flattering it. `paris` is the precision ceiling of any surface-form
resolver: two different things share a name, and nothing in the string
says so. `postgres`, `ibm` and `jorg-muller` are the recall floor: an
abbreviation, an initialism and a transliteration are equivalences that
cannot be derived without evidence, and ADR-0044 decision 3 refuses to

entities.note: the corporate-suffix rule, which is why it exists
a leading article is grammar, not identity
shares a first name with ada-lovelace and must stay distinct
one-token names carry the same rules
PostgreSQL is the same product; no rule can know that (recall floor)
an initialism and its expansion; also a recall floor
transliteration is not derivable; the diacritic form is its own key
the precision ceiling: this and paris-person are one string
a colleague named Paris. Surface-form resolution merges them and is wrong
